agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Git identity in free-form continuation prose must be absent so the preflight gear alone supplies current full object identities.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first pre-push runtime state embedded a reviewed Git identity in prose and the preflight rejected the receipt before publication.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The git-ref evidence binding returned manual-object-id forbidden; the rejected runtime/receipt were preserved and a machine-snapshot-only replacement passed with zero manual ids.

correction.action: Replace every Git identity statement in prose with a machine-snapshot-only declaration and rerun the preflight without changing the implementation candidate.
correction.prevention_control: Every continuation receipt must report zero manually supplied object ids before it can pass.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected free-form Git identity and machine-snapshot-only corrected receipt.

correction.prevention_control: The pre-root deterministic guard and focused regression tests reject wrong contract-family selection before materialisation.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: After live clockwork adoption the active latch and every other canonical governance surface must change only through one passed pointer-last clockwork transaction.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The orchestrator manually advanced the active latch during prelaunch recovery, so the first closeout check rejected canonical drift before running commands or publishing a projection.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The clockwork compared live canonical hashes with its selected generation, rejected before mutation and identified the latch as the only changed canonical path.

correction.action: Restore the active latch byte-for-byte to the selected clockwork generation and rerun the same closeout only after that restoration is committed.
correction.prevention_control: Continuity, Compass, active latch, error register, pattern report and live baton are exclusive clockwork outputs after adoption; ordinary tranche commits must never edit them.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected manual canonical-latch drift and exact single-owner restoration.
